_comment: Runtime profile for Codex (D30, D31, D37-RUNTIME-2). Interactive Codex sessions are not in the beta, so every step on Codex runs without a terminal through codex exec. A review step runs with the read-only sandbox and returns its verdict like any other runtime. Execution on Codex runs only where a flow names it, and stays experimental and untested until a comparison run gives the same result. Placeholders as in claude-code.json. Checked against codex exec --help: exec, resume, -m, --sandbox and the bypass flag. Not yet exercised by a real run: skill_call, session_log, limits and skill_paths. agent_paths follows where the GSD installer writes Codex agents (<CODEX_HOME>/agents/<name>.toml); not yet exercised by a real run.
title: Codex
_comment_credential_env: Issue #119: the variables that hold a login credential. A launcher always removes them, and only the role's account command may set them again (its output is read at launch and never written to a file), so a stale key in a terminal never chooses the account and no secret is written to disk. The start check removes them too.
_comment_account_env: Issue #119: the variables that choose the account folder. A launch sets each one to the caller's value, or removes it when the caller has none, so the terminal's inherited environment never picks the account; with an account command they are removed and the command sets them. Folder paths only, never secrets: the value is written into the launcher.
limits: The /status screen of an interactive Codex session shows the plan's usage limits; codex exec does not report them.
install: install Codex with: npm install -g @openai/codex, then log in with: codex login
